Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City DEC 29 2011 LEGAL SERVICE HON. ANTONIO M. ROMANO, M D Municipal Mayor Municipality of San Andres Province of Catanduanes Dear Mayor Romano: This has reference to your 09 LOCAL GO Vi. PECOPDS RELEAS DATE: TIME'. CONTROL DILG Opinion No. 97 s.2011 November 2011 letter requesting the Department's review and comments on Municipal Ordinance No. 01, s. 2010 vis-å-vis DILG MC No. 2011-151. As indicated in your letter, you cannot disturb the collective consensus of the majority of the Sanggunian by suspending its implementation for reason that said ordinance is presumed valid unless otherwise found to be inconsistent with law. As correctly opined by the Sangguniang Bayan of San Andres, an ordinance enacted by the local sanggunian enjoys the disputable presumption of validity which may only be questioned in the proper forum, i.e., the courts. This is exactly the reason for the issuance of DILG MC No. 2011-151, to give the local sanggunians the benefit of rectifying any excesses in the exercise of their legislative powers which ultimately redounds to the benefit of their constituencies. Not only does the sanggunian have the duty to enact ordinances for the general welfare of its constituencies, but it also has the bounden duty to cause the review, amendment or repeal of its issuances in case of doubts as to validity, as in the case of Municipal Ordinance No. 01, s. 2010 . We hope foregoing sufficiently addresses your concern. Very truly yours, J SUS B Director OQ
